notes.title: Bug Fix 0.3
notes.notes:
It’s been a while since our last patch. During this time, we've been working hard to fix many of the bugs you've reported and improve the overall stability of the game. 

Thanks for your patience and continued support!



Update Notes

Issues with the Plater and Grinder machines have been resolved

Network-related errors have been fixed

Cleaner machine UI has been improved

HUD has been added for certain objects

Disconnection issues in multiplayer have been addressed

Some customer-related bugs have been fixed

Major issues with the cash registers have been largely resolved
